      Terms and conditions
      1. One per company. Limit one basket per company, no matter how many people from that company take a demo.
      2. Who's eligible. Open to business professionals at consumer goods brands who complete a live demo with UpClear. UpClear decides eligibility, including whether a company is a fit for its solutions. Current UpClear clients, UpClear partners and competitors, and government employees are not eligible.
      3. Complete the demo first. The basket ships only after you attend your full scheduled demo. Offer valid for demos completed by December 18, 2026.
      4. What's in it. Up to ten products you choose, with no more than two drinks, oils or sauces per basket. Products are shelf-stable and arrive in their original retail packaging. If an item is unavailable, we'll swap in something similar.
      5. Value. The products have a combined retail value of under $100. No cash value, no cash alternative, and the offer can't be transferred or exchanged.
      6. Shipping. US addresses only. We aim to deliver before the holidays but can't guarantee a delivery date.
      7. Your company's gift policy. You're responsible for making sure accepting the basket fits your employer's rules. You can choose to have it sent to your team or decline it, and the demo is yours either way.
      8. Allergens. Please check each product's label for ingredients and allergens before eating.
      9. Brands and images. The products come from UpClear client brands. Those brands don't sponsor or endorse this offer. The basket shown at the top of this page is an AI-generated illustration; your basket will contain the products you pick.
      10. Your information. We use what you share to schedule your demo, ship your basket and follow up about UpClear.
      11. Changes. UpClear may change or end this offer at any time.
